messages.subject: Project Drake — legal DD request list
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Please find our legal due diligence request list below (corporate, IP/tech, commercial, employment, data protection, tax). We'd be grateful for data room access and responses over the next two to three weeks. We're particularly focused on IP ownership and the open-source position given the software is the core asset.

Regards,
Oliver Jennings
Birchall Stone LLP
